mass.included: Nominal metals/hardware/curtain/cable/welds; actual coatings, upholstery retention and final certified hardware may differ
mass.allocation_note: Includes modeled padding and allocated collar, floor transition, weld and seal mass once. Existing underframe mass is context; final upholstery hardware, coatings and procurement tolerances are not fully modeled.

tolerance_limits: Zero nominal aft strip margin at foot/weld toe X60; construction stack not yet allocated.

Rotated oval cable eye nominal gaps: 0.04550 in to stowed pan, 0.04402 in to cheek and 0.01567 in to OEM free spring cotter; lock cotter/post gap approximately 0.031 in. Installed flexible envelopes and tolerance stacks remain unverified.
Sector/post BREP minimum is 0.068001 in. Circular arc has a continuous 0.05 in bound to the square post boundary; the tang and other parts retain the sampled scope.
Guide key-slot/groove clearances are nominal; final fit, finish, corrosion and wear allowance unresolved.
OEM cotter geometry is its free spring form; elastic shaft contact is expected, not a validated installed envelope.
limitations: Exact Boolean intersections at19sampled angles do not prove continuous motion or finger exclusion.
Constant-length rear curtain and prescribed cable routes need material, snag and physical pinch-probe tests.
No manufacturing/WPS/procurement release; proof, fatigue, vibration, corrosion, fire and accessibility review remain required.

test_method.nominal_state: Unloaded geometry, rigid solids plus prescribed flexible routes.

excluded_groups.context: Reference rails and floor support are audited separately in foundation-independent-audit.json.
excluded_groups.floor: Reference floor panels and cutouts are context; full structural floor integration is open.

test_method.contact_classification: Only matched OEM cotter/shaft elastic contact and same-module cable-eye/swage termination overlaps are classified separately. Exact pair IDs and volumes are enumerated. No general guard, curtain, or moving-part overlap exemption.

schedule.static: All included physical parts in deployed/locked state.
schedule.parked_hardware: Withdrawn pins, parked cotters and routed cables against all fixed physical parts.
schedule.fold: All rigid moving parts and prescribed active curtain against all included physical parts at 0,5,...,90 degrees. Intermediate states use withdrawn pins and parked cotters. End states use engaged pins and cotters.
schedule.pin_withdrawal: 12 equally spaced states from 0 to 1.375 in stroke, on deployed seat.
schedule.pin_parking_turn: 7 states from 0 to 90 degrees at full withdrawal.
schedule.tools: Eight foot bolts, top and bottom: 16 full inserted 1.02 in OD by 3 in socket/straight approach envelopes. Mating bolt, nut and washers excluded.

independent_reviews.bound_scope: Circular sector arc only; tang, other rigid parts and flexible components are not covered by this analytic bound.
independent_reviews.pin_capture: Independent geometric probes show no nominal interference at engaged, withdrawn or parked positions; +/-0.01 in travel produces collar interference at retaining shoulders. This is not a strength test.
